CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.birdtie_connection_decision_receipt_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE r connection_requests%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP <> 'INSERT' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'decision receipt is immutable' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO r FROM connection_requests WHERE id=NEW.request_id;
 IF NOT FOUND OR r.scope<>NEW.scope OR
 (NEW.action='withdraw' AND r.sender_account_id<>NEW.owner_account_id) OR
 (NEW.action<>'withdraw' AND r.recipient_account_id<>NEW.owner_account_id) OR
 NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM accounts WHERE id=NEW.owner_account_id AND account_type='person' AND status='active')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original current human request binding required' USING ERRCODE='23514';END IF;
 IF NEW.status='COMMITTED' AND (r.state<>NEW.state OR NOT EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM connection_requests original WHERE original.id=NEW.request_id
 AND original.xmin::text=(pg_current_xact_id()::text::bigint % 4294967296)::text) OR NOT EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM audit_events a WHERE a.actor_account_id=NEW.owner_account_id
 AND a.resource_type='connection_request' AND a.resource_id=NEW.request_id::text
 AND a.action=NEW.state AND a.decision='allowed' AND a.purpose='human_contact'
 AND a.xmin::text=(pg_current_xact_id()::text::bigint % 4294967296)::text))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'same transaction original decision required' USING ERRCODE='23514';END IF;
 IF NEW.status='NO_EFFECT' AND (NEW.reason IS NULL OR NOT (
 (NEW.reason='EXPIRED' AND r.state='pending' AND r.expires_at<=NEW.recorded_at)
 OR(NEW.reason='ALREADY_DECIDED' AND r.state<>'pending')))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'authoritative pre-effect rejection required' USING ERRCODE='23514';END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.birdtie_guard_moment_thread_member()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$BEGIN
 IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original thread membership is immutable';END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM moment_threads t JOIN moments m ON m.id=NEW.moment_id AND m.author_account_id=t.author_account_id
 WHERE t.id=NEW.thread_id AND((t.audience='PUBLIC' AND t.status='published' AND m.status='published' AND m.visibility='public')
 OR(t.audience='PRIVATE' AND t.status='draft' AND m.status='draft' AND m.visibility='private' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM legacy_native_context_entities x JOIN legacy_native_adaptation_entities n ON n.kind='moment' AND n.target_id=m.id::text AND n.owner_account_id=t.author_account_id AND n.run_id=x.run_id WHERE x.kind='thread' AND x.target_id=t.id AND x.owner_account_id=t.author_account_id))))THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'matching current child and private import provenance required';END IF;RETURN NEW;END$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.birdtie_guard_moment_thread_operation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF TG_OP <> 'INSERT' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'original thread operation is immutable';
    END IF;
    PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(NEW.actor_account_id::text || ':MOMENT_THREAD:' || NEW.operation_id::text, 153));
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounts WHERE id = NEW.actor_account_id
                   AND account_type = 'person' AND status = 'active') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'active Person required';
    END IF;
    IF NEW.receipt->>'schemaVersion'='moment-thread-operation-v2' THEN
      IF NEW.status<>'SUCCEEDED' OR NEW.receipt->>'operationId'<>NEW.operation_id::text OR NEW.receipt->>'status'<>'SUCCEEDED'
      OR NEW.receipt->>'action' NOT IN('EDIT','WITHDRAW') OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.receipt->'members') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.receipt->'removedMembers') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
      OR jsonb_array_length(NEW.receipt->'removedMembers')>20
      OR jsonb_array_length(NEW.receipt->'removedMembers')<>(SELECT count(DISTINCT r->>'momentId') FROM jsonb_array_elements(NEW.receipt->'removedMembers') r)
      OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM moment_threads t JOIN moment_thread_edit_states e ON e.thread_id=t.id WHERE t.id=NEW.thread_id AND t.author_account_id=NEW.actor_account_id AND e.operation_id=NEW.operation_id AND e.version=t.version
        AND NEW.receipt->>'threadId'=t.id::text AND NEW.receipt->>'rootMomentId'=t.root_moment_id::text AND NEW.receipt->>'audience'='PUBLIC'
        AND (NEW.receipt->>'appliedVersion')::bigint=t.version AND (NEW.receipt->>'expectedVersion')::bigint=t.version-1 AND NEW.receipt->>'payloadDigest'=encode(NEW.payload_sha256,'hex')
        AND ((NEW.receipt->>'action'='EDIT' AND t.status='published')OR(NEW.receipt->>'action'='WITHDRAW' AND t.status='withdrawn'))
        AND jsonb_array_length(NEW.receipt->'members')=(SELECT count(*) FROM moment_thread_display_members d WHERE d.thread_id=t.id AND d.display_position IS NOT NULL)
        AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(NEW.receipt->'members') WITH ORDINALITY q(r,n) WHERE (r->>'position')::integer<>n-1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM moment_thread_display_members d JOIN moments m ON m.id=d.moment_id WHERE d.thread_id=t.id AND d.display_position=(r->>'position')::integer AND m.id::text=r->>'momentId' AND m.revision=(r->>'appliedRevision')::bigint AND m.status=r->>'status' AND ((NEW.receipt->>'action'='EDIT' AND m.status='published' AND m.visibility='public')OR(NEW.receipt->>'action'='WITHDRAW' AND m.status='withdrawn'))))
        AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(NEW.receipt->'removedMembers') r WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM moment_thread_display_members d JOIN moment_thread_members x ON x.thread_id=d.thread_id AND x.moment_id=d.moment_id JOIN moments m ON m.id=d.moment_id WHERE d.thread_id=t.id AND d.display_position IS NULL AND x.position=(r->>'position')::integer AND m.id::text=r->>'momentId' AND m.revision=(r->>'appliedRevision')::bigint AND m.status='withdrawn' AND r->>'status'='withdrawn'))
      ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'matching approved edited thread effect required';END IF;
      RETURN NEW;
    END IF;
    IF NEW.receipt->>'schemaVersion'  <> 'moment-thread-operation-v1'
       OR NEW.receipt->>'operationId' <> NEW.operation_id::text
       OR NEW.receipt->>'status' <> NEW.status THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'matching original receipt required';
    END IF;
    IF NEW.status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM moment_threads t WHERE t.id = NEW.thread_id
          AND t.author_account_id = NEW.actor_account_id
          AND NEW.receipt->>'threadId' = t.id::text
          AND NEW.receipt->>'rootMomentId' = t.root_moment_id::text
          AND (NEW.receipt->>'appliedVersion')::bigint = t.version
          AND NEW.receipt->>'payloadDigest' = encode(NEW.payload_sha256, 'hex')
          AND ((NEW.receipt->>'action' = 'CREATE_PUBLISH' AND t.status = 'published' AND t.version = 1)
            OR (NEW.receipt->>'action' = 'PUBLISH' AND t.status='published' AND t.audience='PUBLIC' AND t.version>1)
            OR (NEW.receipt->>'action' = 'WITHDRAW' AND t.status = 'withdrawn'))
          AND jsonb_array_length(NEW.receipt->'members') =
              (SELECT count(*) FROM moment_thread_members WHERE thread_id = t.id)
          AND NOT EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(NEW.receipt->'members') r
              WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM moment_thread_members x JOIN moments m ON m.id = x.moment_id
                    WHERE x.thread_id = t.id AND x.position = (r->>'position')::integer
                      AND x.moment_id::text = r->>'momentId'
                      AND m.revision = (r->>'appliedRevision')::bigint
                      AND m.status = r->>'status')
          )
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'matching complete canonical thread effect required';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.birdtie_guard_public_video_payload()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE attachment record; slot record;
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'video payload identity retained';END IF;
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN
  -- A no-op on an already retired row must not manufacture same-transaction
  -- provenance through xmin. The normal retirement writers select non-NULL bytes.
  IF OLD.content IS NULL OR NEW.content IS NOT NULL OR NEW.retired_xact_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.retired_xact_id
  OR (to_jsonb(NEW)-'content'-'retired_xact_id') IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-'content'-'retired_xact_id') THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'only live video byte retirement allowed';END IF;
  NEW.retired_xact_id:=pg_current_xact_id();
  RETURN NEW;
 END IF;
 SELECT * INTO attachment FROM public_moment_media_attachments WHERE moment_id=NEW.moment_id AND set_version=NEW.set_version AND position=NEW.position;
 SELECT * INTO slot FROM public_moment_media_sets WHERE moment_id=NEW.moment_id;
 IF NEW.content IS NULL OR NEW.retired_xact_id IS NOT NULL
 OR attachment.media_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.media_id OR attachment.media_version IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.media_version
 OR slot.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'READY' OR slot.version IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.set_version
 OR attachment.display IS NULL OR attachment.metadata->>'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'VIDEO'
 OR attachment.metadata->'video' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.contract
 OR NEW.contract->>'videoSha256' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.sha256::text
 OR NOT (
  EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM moment_media_video_materials v JOIN moment_media_materials m ON m.id=v.media_id
   WHERE v.media_id=NEW.media_id AND m.version=NEW.media_version AND m.owner_account_id=slot.owner_account_id
   AND m.retain_until>clock_timestamp() AND v.content=NEW.content AND v.sha256=NEW.sha256)
  OR EXISTS(
   SELECT 1 FROM public_moment_media_video_payloads prior_video
   JOIN public_moment_media_attachments prior USING(moment_id,set_version,position)
   JOIN moments m ON m.id=prior_video.moment_id
   JOIN accounts owner ON owner.id=m.author_account_id
   WHERE prior_video.moment_id=NEW.moment_id AND prior_video.position=NEW.position
   AND prior_video.set_version=NEW.set_version-2
   AND prior_video.media_id=NEW.media_id AND prior_video.media_version=NEW.media_version
   AND prior.media_id=NEW.media_id AND prior.media_version=NEW.media_version
   AND prior_video.content IS NULL AND prior.display IS NULL AND prior.thumbnail IS NULL
   AND prior_video.retired_xact_id=pg_current_xact_id()
   AND prior.xmin::text=(pg_current_xact_id()::text::numeric % 4294967296)::text
   AND m.xmin::text=(pg_current_xact_id()::text::numeric % 4294967296)::text
   AND m.author_account_id=slot.owner_account_id AND owner.account_type='person' AND owner.status='active'
   AND m.status='published' AND m.visibility='public' AND m.revision=slot.approved_moment_revision
   AND m.author_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND m.published_at IS NOT NULL
   AND m.author_confirmed_at<=m.published_at AND m.published_at<=clock_timestamp()
   AND prior_video.sha256=NEW.sha256
   AND prior_video.contract-'videoPath'=NEW.contract-'videoPath'
   AND prior_video.contract->>'videoPath'='/v1/moments/'||NEW.moment_id::text||'/public-media/'||(m.revision-1)::text||'/'||prior_video.set_version::text||'/'||NEW.media_id::text||'/'||NEW.media_version::text||'/video'
   AND NEW.contract->>'videoPath'='/v1/moments/'||NEW.moment_id::text||'/public-media/'||m.revision::text||'/'||NEW.set_version::text||'/'||NEW.media_id::text||'/'||NEW.media_version::text||'/video'
   AND prior.metadata->'video'=prior_video.contract
   AND prior.metadata-ARRAY['displayPath','thumbnailPath','expiresAt','video']=attachment.metadata-ARRAY['displayPath','thumbnailPath','expiresAt','video']
   AND prior.rights=attachment.rights AND prior.retention_until=attachment.retention_until
   AND attachment.retention_until>clock_timestamp()
   AND attachment.rights->>'canRetain'='true' AND attachment.rights->>'canPublish'='true'
   AND encode(sha256(attachment.display),'hex')=prior.metadata->>'displaySha256'
   AND encode(sha256(attachment.thumbnail),'hex')=prior.metadata->>'thumbnailSha256'
   AND octet_length(attachment.display)=(prior.metadata->>'displayBytes')::integer
   AND octet_length(attachment.thumbnail)=(prior.metadata->>'thumbnailBytes')::integer
  )
 ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact approved canonical video copy required';END IF;
 -- The table CHECK independently verifies NEW.content against this immutable SHA.
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.birdtie_guard_moment_location_epoch()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'persistent Moment location epoch required';END IF;
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND(NEW.moment_id<>OLD.moment_id OR NEW.version<>OLD.version+1)THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'monotone Moment location epoch required';END IF;RETURN NEW;END$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.birdtie_guard_moment_location()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Moment location tombstone required';END IF;
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND(OLD.status='REMOVED' OR NEW.id<>OLD.id OR NEW.moment_id<>OLD.moment_id OR NEW.kind<>OLD.kind OR NEW.city_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.city_id OR NEW.place_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.place_id OR NEW.reference_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.reference_id OR NEW.revision<>OLD.revision+1)THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'stable Moment location identity required';END IF;
 RETURN NEW;END $function$
